name: edge-justification-worksheet
post_title: The Topology You Can Review Is the Topology You Can Run
description: Per-edge worksheet that forces every proposed agent-to-agent edge to name its forcing constraint (context pollution, parallelism, or specialization), its risk tier, its four-field delegation spec, its review node, and both bills — token and reviewer-minute — with a checker that deletes any edge holding an empty or invalid cell
